In verifySafeHtml(), IO failures are rethrown as RuntimeException, while verify() otherwise reports IO problems as MojoExecutionException - exception types should be consistent for easier plugin failure interpretation
The prefix/suffix trimming (start/end) can yield overlapping indices which would throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException and abort verification - needs an overlap/bounds guard
The error message 'Didn't find anchor tag ...' doesn't include the message key or file, making it hard to locate the failing translation in large bundles
Lithuanian bundle has totpStep1 set to Italian text ('Installa una delle seguenti…') which is a copy/paste mismatch - same issue appears in the login bundle
